Package org.apache.hadoop.yarn.webapp.hamlet2

@LimitedPrivate({"YARN","MapReduce"}) package org.apache.hadoop.yarn.webapp.hamlet2
This package is the replacement for org.apache.hadoop.yarn.webapp.hamlet. The old package is using _ as a one-character identifier, which is banned from JDK9.
